items.claim: Exclusion cannot hide a declared copy
items.evidence: Lines 901-903 extract a quoted Python-repr path without decoding escaped backslashes. For the actual restricted-account error, _plain_path(parsed) differs from the actual directory's normalised path. An in-memory declared member beneath protected_b2d1b6e9, with bytes supplied by a narrow read stub, was excluded and G19 returned OK. The same control using a literal forward-slash error correctly returned ROOT_WALK_ERRORS_OVER_DECLARED_COPY. An unparseable fixture-marked error also returned OK.

Actual G19 execution now returns OK with 11 fixture exclusions. The real WinError 5 at FHS_W0W2_R4_20261107/inc3/work/acl_probe2/protected_b2d1b6e9 remains observable but is excluded. This baseline success does not establish exclusion safety.
